## 🚀 DocuFlow Studio Pro v1.0.0

DocuFlow Studio Pro v1.0.0 introduces PDFella-grade in-place vector PDF editing, freehand drawings, digital signatures, AutoCAD DWG & DXF blueprint conversions, universal multi-document fusion, offline OCR

releaseInfo.tagline: DocuFlow Studio Pro v1.0.0 Official GitHub Release
newFeatures: DocuFlow Studio Pro v1.0.0 introduces PDFella-grade in-place vector PDF editing, freehand drawings, digital signatures, AutoCAD DWG & DXF blueprint conversions, universal multi-document fusion, offline OCR vision, and 1-to-1 batch office conversion.

PDFella-Grade PDF Editor: In-place text editing with instant font replacement, live freehand pen drawings, digital signature pad (draw, type, upload), whiteout redaction, shapes, stamps, and page manager sidebar
AutoCAD DWG & DXF Vector Blueprint Engine: Direct client-side parsing of AutoCAD drawings (R14 to 2026) via LibreDWG WebAssembly with Blueprint and Monochrome themes up to A1 paper size
Universal Heterogeneous Multi-Document Fusion: Combine arbitrary combinations of Word, Excel, AutoCAD DWG/DXF, Images, Text, and PDFs into one master PDF
PDF Page Studio & Visual Splitter: Thumbnail grid to reorder, rotate 90°, delete pages, extract ranges (e.g., 1-3, 5), or split all to ZIP
Offline OCR Vision Extractor: Client-side optical character recognition via Tesseract for scanned and flattened PDFs

## 🚀 MediaFlow Studio v6.0.0
Professional Media Ingestion, Synchronization and Report Fusion Desktop Suite.

### ✨ What's Included:

- **1:1 Anything Ecosystem Synchronization**: Native loader configuration and cross-app launcher integration.
- **PV Separation Engine**: High-performance photo and video grouping and verification.
- **Automated Windows Installer**: Clean NSIS desktop and start menu shortcuts with auto-updater support.
